about_short_description.short_description: OpenGov is a digital cloud software provider that helps local governments and state agencies run government operations.

product.name: OpenGov Public Service Platform
product.description: A cloud-based government operations platform that connects finance, permitting, public works, procurement, budgeting, revenue, and resident services across departments.

product.name: OpenGov ERP
product.description: A government-focused enterprise resource planning system that connects financial management, budgeting, procurement, payroll, billing, revenue, grants, and other administrative operations.

product.name: OpenGov Enterprise Asset Management
product.description: A public-sector asset management system for tracking infrastructure, managing work orders, planning maintenance, and evaluating asset condition and lifecycle costs.

product.name: OpenGov Permitting & Licensing
product.description: A government permitting and licensing system for processing building permits, business licenses, inspections, zoning matters, right-of-way permits, and code enforcement cases.

product.name: OpenGov Financial Management
product.description: A government financial management system covering general ledger, financial reporting, accounts payable, accounts receivable, requisitions, bank reconciliation, and fixed assets.

product.name: OpenGov Budgeting & Performance
product.description: A collaborative government budgeting and performance management system for operating budgets, workforce planning, capital planning, performance reporting, and online budget publication.
